WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) AS max_month
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
months AS (
  SELECT
    gs.month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(b.max_month - INTERVAL '11 months', b.max_month, INTERVAL '1 month') AS gs(month_start)
),
revenue_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month_start,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op
    ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  STRFTIME(m.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN revenue_by_month r
  ON r.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;
